uutiset.t: Rupee Hits 8-Month High as India November Stock Inflows Reach $14.7 Billion: INR
uutiset.s: ANZ Banking Group sees room for the rupee to gain further to 90-91 per dollar.

uutiset.t: Hawkish Bank of Japan Member Seeks Quick Rate Hikes On Inflation
uutiset.s: A hawkish member of the Bank of Japan’s policy board called for early action to keep raising the BOJ’s benchmark rate, supporting market expectations for a rate hike next month.

uutiset.t: KK Mart Starts $112 Million IPO Delayed by Malaysia Socks Row
uutiset.s: KK Mart Retail Bhd., the Malaysian convenience-store chain whose first attempt at an initial public offering was delayed by a religious controversy, is launching a 462 million ringgit ($112 million) share sale as it prepares to add hundreds of outlets across the country.

uutiset.t: Copper Rebounds From Lowest This Year as Volatility Grips Metals
uutiset.s: Copper jumped more than 3% from an 11-month low, tracking gains in tech stocks even as doubts lingered over the durability of the AI boom and related industrial metals demand.

uutiset.t: Shein’s Slow India Start Lays Bare Limits of Billionaire Ambani’s Retail Might
uutiset.s: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s return to India through a local partner is off to a slow start, due to supply chain snags, leadership uncertainty and a lack of proprietary technology that made the fast-fashion brand a hit.

uutiset.t: Rupee Has Room to Rally Before RBI Steps In, Strategists Say
uutiset.s: India’s rupee is pulling away from its Asian peers, and strategists say the rally has further to run before the central bank steps in to buy dollars.

uutiset.t: Situational Awareness Lost 65% in Wild Third Quarter, WSJ Says
uutiset.s: Situational Awareness told investors it lost 65% after fees in the third quarter, after highly levered bets on artificial intelligence firms nearly led to the hedge fund’s implosion in July, according to the Wall Street Journal.

uutiset.t: Lula Sounds Out Bradesco’s Luiz Trabuco to Join His Government
uutiset.s: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has sounded out Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco Cappi about joining his fourth-term government, according to people familiar with the matter, a move that could help ease investor concerns over Brazil’s deteriorating fiscal outlook.

uutiset.t: Australia Capex Surges by Most Since Mining Boom on Data Centers
uutiset.s: Australian business investment surged by the most since the peak of the mining boom in the three months through September, driven by data center-related spending in a bright spot for an otherwise cooling economy.

uutiset.t: Modi’s Criticism of India Inc. Puts Weak Investment in Focus
uutiset.s: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s sharp criticism of Indian businesses last week exposed an underlying weakness in the economy’s booming growth story.

uutiset.t: Gold Edges Lower as US Inflation Data Fuels Bets for Rate Hikes
uutiset.s: Gold edged lower, after rising on Wednesday, as inflation data reinforced bets the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates further.

uutiset.t: Emerging Asia’s Best Bond Rally Seen Extending in Philippines
uutiset.s: Philippine government bonds look poised to build on this month’s sharp rally as expectations of easing price pressures and a landmark global index inclusion may stimulate fresh demand next year, according to some market watchers.

uutiset.t: China 2027 Growth to Top 4.5%, Ex-Official Says
uutiset.s: China’s economy is on track to grow more than 4.5% in 2027, according to former Vice Finance Minister Zhu Guangyao. uutiset.t: Would-Be RadioShack Revivers Settle SEC Fraud Suit Allegations
uutiset.s: Three entrepreneurs accused of misleading investors about pandemic-era plans to revive distressed retailers including RadioShack and Pier 1 Imports agreed to pay more than $6.8 million to end a US regulator’s lawsuit claiming they were running a Ponzi-like scam.

uutiset.t: How Saks Is Reclaiming Luxury as Exemplar Luxury Group
uutiset.s: Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick reports on how Exemplar Luxury Group, formerly known as Saks Global, is reinventing itself for a fresh start in luxury since emerging from bankruptcy earlier this year.
